objective: Execute GCL-10 — Adventure Structure Library. Build reusable modular adventure architectures that compose GCL-02 through GCL-06 while preserving CSW-05 pre-authoritative planning and D28/F005/F012 runtime authority boundaries.

acceptance_profile.breadth: 160 deterministic adventure structures: 20 adventure families × 8 architecture patterns, exceeding the GCL-18 proof target of 50 adventure structures/variants.
acceptance_profile.modularity: Every structure exposes replaceable hooks, situations, encounter roles, objectives/stakes, complications, routes, optional content and endpoints.
acceptance_profile.projections: Ready-to-use and construction-material projections are both first-class and have no hidden defaults.
acceptance_profile.nonlinearity: Linear structures are permitted but no golden path, forced route, mandatory solution or automatic success is created.
acceptance_profile.authority: No D28 identity creation, Campaign/Scene/Session mutation, live Encounter mutation, runtime outcome assertion, auto-incorporation or completeness guarantee.

nonauthorization: D28 Adventure identity or truth mutation
next_action: Build, validate, merge and close GCL-10 while preserving the active SEC-05 application authority.
